title: Evidence Tiering Playbook and Auto-Bundle Generator for Security & Compliance Requests
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Create a repeatable playbook and automation service that maps incoming security and compliance questionnaire items (SOC2, ISO, HIPAA, GDPR/DPA, vendor RFIs) to minimal, pre-approved evidence snippets and assembles account-appropriate evidence bundles. The goal is to reduce time-to-response for customer asks, standardize answers, and lower engineering/Legal overhead for repeat request types.
goals: 1) Reduce average turnaround on vendor questionnaires by 60% for standard asks. 2) Provide a semi-automated evidence bundle generator that outputs a tailored package (answers + proof artifacts) for each account tier. 3) Surface triage confidence and risk flags for non-standard asks to accelerate escalation.
scope_inclusions: - Mapping of top 120 questionnaire fields to canonical evidence snippets. - UI in the Console for selecting account tier / sensitivity and previewing bundles. - Backend service that composes/verifies attachments from our artifact store (Confluence + S3). - Audit logging and template versioning.
scope_exclusions: - Full natural language answer synthesis for heavily customized legal responses. - New contractual changes (DPA edits) — those still route to Legal. - On-prem packaging beyond generating a zip of artifacts (no deployment of tools to customer infra in this phase).
success_metrics: - Median response time for standard questionnaires reduced from 10 days to <=4 days. - 75% of inbound vendor RFIs handled with auto-bundles without manual edits. - Reduction of Legal/SE FTE-hours spent per request by 50% measured over quarter.
acceptance_criteria: - Evidence mapping table completed for top 120 fields with owners assigned. - Auto-bundle generator outputs a bundle containing: answers.json (canonical answers), attachments manifest, and 1-click download. - Console preview shows per-item source, last-reviewed timestamp, and risk flag. - Audit log entry created for each generated bundle and stored for 1 year. - End-to-end test that simulates a standard SOC2 questionnaire and produces a human-readable bundle passes CI.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal beta): limited to Support + Sales engineering for low-risk accounts. Phase 2 (pilot): opt-in for existing enterprise customers identified by CSMs. Phase 3 (general availability): enable for all accounts with role-based access and throttling controls.
stakeholders: Product: Aisha Khan; Engineering: Marco Rivera, Priya Singh; Legal: Daniel O'Connor; Support: Lina Morales; CSM: Kevin Zhang; Design: Noor Patel
dependencies_notes: Depends on artifact canonicalization work (PM-22457) and the LLM-assisted intake classifier spike (PM-56109) for routing non-standard items. Also requires S3 read-only access for the evidence store and a Confluence canonical pages index.
comments: 2025-01-20 - Kickoff: Cross-functional kickoff with Legal and Support. Action: Priya to scope backend adapter for S3/Confluence. Marco assigned as eng lead.
2025-01-28 - Mapping draft: 60/120 fields mapped. Legal requested clearer provenance metadata per snippet (source doc + last-reviewed). Added to ACs.
2025-02-01 - Design review: Noor submitted Console preview mocks. Feedback: show account residency and redaction hints for PII-sensitive artifacts.
2025-02-04 - Risk decision: We will treat any field that requests user-level logs as 'escalate to SE' rather than auto-answer. Trade-off accepted to avoid accidental data exposure.
2025-02-05 - Implementation note: Backend will sign temporary S3 URLs and produce a signed bundle zip. Need security review for URL expiration policy (default 72 hours).
decisions: - Adopt three evidence tiers (Light, Standard, Full) mapped to account contract tier and data sensitivity. - Keep synthesis limited: canonical snippets only; no free-text LLM answers in Phase 1. - Audit logs must include snippet version and generating user ID.
open_risks: - Canonical snippets may become stale; need quarterly review cadence. - Some customers require jurisdiction-specific evidence variants (EU/UK) which will require content branching. - Potential spike in support load when pilot opens if bundles are incomplete.
next_steps: - Engineering: Spike on bundle composer + signed URL flow (owner: Marco). - Legal: Complete provenance metadata for remaining 60 fields (owner: Daniel). - Design: Prepare Console preview for internal beta (owner: Noor). - Ops: Provision read-only S3 role and Confluence index (owner: Lina).
qa_checklist: - Unit tests for mapping table lookups. - Integration test for bundle generation with mocked S3/Confluence. - Penetration review of signed URL expiry and access controls. - Manual review of 10 sampled auto-bundles by Legal.
notes: This ticket intentionally focuses on automation for repeatable asks. More complex contract negotiations and DPA edits remain a separate flow routed to Legal. We anticipate close collaboration with the Support team to surface the most common questionnaire variants during pilot.
estimated_impact: High time savings for enterprise customer responses and improved perceptual reliability when customers ask for compliance evidence.
